verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only API endpoints for managing upgrades, downgrades and seat changes, and list endpoints a developer could use to build a customer-facing page. Those are developer building blocks, not a hosted self-serve portal or embeddable components. The truncated marketing line about a customizable in-product billing dashboard never says customers can change or cancel plans themselves.

support.subject: As a founder, my customers can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel themselves through a hosted portal or embeddable components, without a support ticket
